title: 海边贝壳
scene: A cheerful seaside still life of ONLY TWO oversized beautiful seashells and ONE chunky smiling starfish arranged playfully. One broad scallop shell has ONLY TWO simple flowing internal division curves making THREE broad flutes; no dense ridges. The second is a big smooth conch shell with just one large open curving spiral accent, NO tiny nested spirals or narrow lip/rim stripes. Starfish has five broad soft arms, simple solid-black dot eyes and an open smile, NO tiny dots or sucker patterns. Background pure empty white; no sand granules, horizon, bubbles, waves or decorative objects. Aim for only 8–12 broad closed coloring areas, absolutely no tiny slivers.
